instagram.caption:
ADHD and freelancing: when you know exactly what to do, but can't start 🫠

One Monday, one client proposal:

1. 9:00 "Today I send the proposal."
2. 10:30 Opened the doc. Checked my email instead.
3. 1:00 Reorganized my whole Notion. Twice.
4. 3:00 I knew exactly what to write. I just couldn't start.

What worked: I told FOCO the task, broke it into tiny steps with one tap, and started ONLY step 1 (open last proposal as a template) with a 3 min timer and jazzy music.

4:10 Sent. She said yes.

📌 Save this for your next proposal day, and send it to a freelancer friend who gets it.
💜 Try FOCO, link in bio.
